svg.title: Thus the bound is independent of the number of copied chambers. For the summit calendar take J = i and m0 its prescribed basin. The surgery window radius and the necessary separation radius are subpower functions of bβk; the calendar’s block ratio eventually exceeds them uniformly in the volume. Its treasury and weight choices make the right side of (TS8) at most T−1900000 . The same window fits the reporting chamber. This establishes the local estimate i used in (TS6), with the finite surgery expense conditions displayed above.
